title: Tor groups of modules (Stacks 00LY)
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring and $M,N$ be $B$-modules. Choose a resolution $\cdots\to F_2\to F_1\to F_0\to M\to0$ of $M$ by projective (for instance free) $B$-modules. For $i\ge0$, $\operatorname{Tor}^B_i(M,N)$ is the $i$-th homology module of the complex $\cdots\to F_2\otimes_BN\to F_1\otimes_BN\to F_0\otimes_BN\to0$. It is a $B$-module, independent of the chosen resolution up to canonical isomorphism, and functorial in $M$ and $N$; $\operatorname{Tor}^B_0(M,N)=M\otimes_BN$.
